children: Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY), a leading global materials science and digital identification solutions company, will speak to the investment community during its High-Value Category Investor Showcase on September 23, 2026 in Mentor, Ohio. Avery Dennison senior management will host a briefing from 9:30 a.m. to approximately 11:45 a.m. Eastern time, discussing the company’s high-value category portfolio and industry trends driving future opportunities. The presentation will be followed by a live Q&A. Those attending in person will also experience demonstrations and showcases of key high-value category products and solutions.
The event will be webcast live and a replay will be available on Avery Dennison's Investor Relations website at
. If you would like to attend in person, please register by September 18, 2026.

Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste and mitigate loss, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2025 were $8.9 billion. Learn more at
